modes.title: Game Modes
modes.intro: Tic Tac Dunk offers two ways to test your NBA knowledge.
modes.daily: Complete a 3×3 grid by finding NBA players who match the row and column criteria.
modes.ticTacToe: Challenge a bot in an NBA trivia twist on classic tic-tac-toe. Multiplayer is coming soon.

shared.title: Shared rules
shared.intro: Both modes share the same basic gameplay:
shared.grid: Each grid has 3 rows and 3 columns, each with its own criterion.
shared.select: Select a square and find an NBA player who matches both its row and column criteria.
shared.submit: Submit your answer to claim the square.

criteria.title: Possible criteria
criteria.intro: Rows and columns can use any of the following criteria. Your answer must satisfy both criteria for the selected square.

team.title: NBA team
team.description: Choose a player who has played for the team shown.

teammate.title: Teammate of a player
teammate.description: Choose a player who was a teammate of the named player.

mvpOrDpoy.title: MVP or DPOY
mvpOrDpoy.description: Choose a player who has won the NBA Most Valuable Player or Defensive Player of the Year award. Either award counts.

royOrMip.title: ROY or MIP
royOrMip.description: Choose a player who has won the NBA Rookie of the Year or Most Improved Player award. Either award counts.

points.title: 2,000+ points in a season
points.description: Choose a player who scored at least 2,000 points in a single NBA season.

daily.title: Daily Puzzle
daily.goal: Fill all 9 squares with matching NBA players to complete the puzzle.
daily.schedule: A new puzzle is available every day.

ticTacToe.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
ticTacToe.opponent: Take turns against a bot on the NBA grid.
ticTacToe.timer: You have 24 seconds to answer on each turn.
ticTacToe.correct: A correct answer claims the square.
ticTacToe.incorrect: A wrong answer skips your turn.
ticTacToe.win: Claim 3 squares in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win.
